scope: All parent tracked md/txt/rst/adoc/html, plus extensionless/JSON/YAML changelog/release/history/news/changes/readme/issue paths; literal full SHA, 7-char SHA and sanitized subject; numeric issue/PR and JIRA-style identifiers separately flagged
limits: No external issue text was fetched. Only issue material already tracked in the parent was available.
No semantic/paraphrase, all-source, branch-independent or package-level blindness guarantee.
An issue-identifier occurrence is a potential preannouncement pointer, not proof of future fix leakage.
